dishes.name: Pickert
dishes.desc: Thick yeast-and-potato pancake, fried and eaten with butter, jam or sausage. A farmhouse bread from Westphalia that is common around Osnabrück.

dishes.name: Emsland buckwheat pancake
dishes.desc: Thin pancake of buckwheat flour with bacon, fried in a pan. Buckwheat grew on the sandy Emsland soils and the pancake stayed on local menus.

dishes.name: Smoked Dümmer eel
dishes.desc: Eel from Lake Dümmer on the edge of Vechta and Osnabrück land, smoked and eaten on dark bread. Sold from local smokehouses.

dishes.name: Bentheimer Landschwein roast
dishes.desc: Pork from the rare Bentheimer Landschwein breed, raised in the Grafschaft Bentheim and served on regional menus as roast or sausage.
